x_938076_backup_0_backup_scripts.description:
This script reverts the new icons introduced in the Coral theme built for the Zurich release back to the previous icons.
Key Details:- Provides a fix for reverting to the previous icons One-time operation that is irreversible New icons cannot be restored after execution Before running, set runManually to true to confirm
Caution: The Script should only be executed once. Carefully review before proceeding.
x_938076_backup_0_backup_scripts.name: Coral Theme Icon Restoration Script
